name: FC Porto vs Estoril Praia
description: FC Porto host Estoril Praia at the Estádio do Dragão on Saturday 31 October at 20:30. Tickets via Gomry from US$87.05 (resale prices).
longDescription:
FC Porto play Estoril Praia at home at the Estádio do Dragão on Saturday 31 October at 20:30. Kickoff times can still be moved by the league, so check before you go.

The stadium has its own metro stop, Estádio do Dragão (lines A, B, E and F).

Tickets are sold through Gomry, a resale platform. Listed prices start at US$87.05.
descriptionPt: O FC Porto recebe o Estoril Praia no Estádio do Dragão, sábado, 31 de outubro, às 20:30. Bilhetes via Gomry desde US$87.05 (preços de revenda).
